mechanism: Bupropion inhibits CYP2D6, which metabolizes sacubitril's active metabolite (LBQ657), potentially increasing sacubitril exposure and vasodilatory effects; additive risk of hypotension and syncope.
action: Monitor blood pressure and renal function closely; consider dose adjustment of sacubitril if hypotension or syncope develops; use combination cautiously in elderly or volume-depleted patients.
